task_completion.description: Open Wireshark and load the specified pcapng file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Wireshark window is open showing '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' in the title bar or file path.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Display Filter Macros configuration dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Display Filter Macros' dialog box is visible (usually found under Analyze -> Display Filter Macros).

task_completion.description: Create a macro named 'tcp_bad_quality' with the correct filter string.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A row in the Macros dialog shows Name: 'tcp_bad_quality' and Filter: 'tcp.analysis.retransmission || tcp.analysis.fast_retransmission || tcp.analysis.spurious_retransmission'.

task_completion.description: Apply the created macro to the current capture using the macro syntax.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wireshark display filter bar contains '${tcp_bad_quality}' and the background is green (valid syntax).

task_completion.description: Record the resulting packet count into the specified text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows '0' being saved to '~/Documents/packet_count.txt'.

integrity.description: Verify the macro was created via the Wireshark GUI, not just manually filtered.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'Display Filter Macros' dialog box being populated and saved.

integrity.description: Verify the agent is interacting with the actual 200722_tcp_anon.pcapng file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The packet list pane shows TCP traffic consistent with the netcat capture (35 total packets before filtering).

integrity.description: Verify the agent derived the count from the UI status bar after applying the filter.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Wireshark status bar at the bottom shows 'Displayed: 0 (0.0%)' after the macro is applied.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The macro name must be exactly 'tcp_bad_quality'. The filter string is 'tcp.analysis.retransmission || tcp.analysis.fast_retransmission || tcp.analysis.spurious_retransmission'. When this filter is applied to '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng', the resulting packet count is 0. The output file ~/Documents/packet_count.txt must contain the integer 0.
